items.question: What identity must the wise practitioner recognize in the primordial great goddess?
premises: The primordial one is designated as the great goddess.
This great goddess is identified as Surasundarī.
The wise practitioner is enjoined to know her in this form.
items.inference: Therefore the primordial great goddess is to be recognized as Surasundarī.
uncertainties: The precise referent of sura in surasundarīm may be divine or god-related.
items.plain_english: And indeed, the wise one should know the primordial great goddess as Surasundarī.
